For the Petitioner : Mr. Yasir Arafat, Advocate For the Respondents :
Mrs. Nirupama, A.C. to Sr.S.C.-II Order No. 03 Dated: 07.04.2025 The present writ petition has been filed for issuance of direction upon the concerned respondents to pay adequate compensation to the petitioner as per prevailing rate in the locality for construction of village road on his private land appertaining to Jamabandi No. 22, plot no. 895, Jamanbandi No. 158, plot no. 905, Jamabandi No. 106 plot nos. 919 & 920, Mouza- Amritpur, P.S. Maheshpur, District- Pakur measuring area of 800 ft. x 20 ft. with respect to connecting high level bridge on Basloi river.

Further prayer has been made to provide the benefits to the petitioner in view of the "Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013".

sentences.text: 2. Mrs. Nirupama, learned A.C. to Sr.S.C.-II appearing on behalf of the respondents, submits that the aforesaid claim of the petitioner is required to be factually examined by the competent authority i.e., the respondent no. 5-the District Land Acquisition Officer, Pakur.
Hence, if the petitioner prefers a fresh representation on the present issue, an appropriate decision will be taken by the said respondent within a time frame.

3. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering the nature of prayer made in the writ petition, without entering into the merit of the case, the petitioner is given liberty to prefer a fresh representation on the present issue before the respondent no. 5.

On receipt of the said representation, the respondent no. 5, after examining the relevant records and on providing an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner/his representative, shall take an appropriate informed decision within eight weeks from the date of filing of the said representation.
4. The writ petition is accordingly disposed of with aforesaid liberty and direction.

Ritesh/ (Rajesh Shankar, J.)
